sentences.en: Their feelings are intense and they tend to be jealous.
sentences.zh: 他们的情感非常强烈，容易嫉妒。

sentences.en: It made her jealous to see him walking with another girl.
sentences.zh: 看到他和另一个女孩走在一起，让她很嫉妒。

sentences.en: She was jealous when he talked to another girl.
sentences.zh: 当他和其他女孩说话时，她感到很嫉妒。

senses.zh: 妒忌的，好嫉妒的；珍惜的；猜疑的，留意提防的；（神祇）要求绝对忠实和崇敬的
